# Color Picker

Edit an exact color through native, text, channel, and spatial controls.

## Usage

### Native

Use the browser color input while keeping the same exact color value as the text controls.

<ComponentExample component="color-picker" scenario="native" title="Native" description="Use the browser color input while keeping the same exact color value as the text controls." :index="0" />

### Alpha

Edit the alpha channel together with the visible color channels.

<ComponentExample component="color-picker" scenario="alpha" title="Alpha" description="Edit the alpha channel together with the visible color channels." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="color-picker" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

#### `ColorAreaValue`

| Name | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `number` | Yes |
| `y` | `number` | Yes |
| `hue` | `number` | Yes |
| `alpha` | `number` | Yes |

#### `ColorChannel`

```ts
type ColorChannel = 'red' | 'green' | 'blue' | 'alpha'
```

#### `ColorCoordinate`

```ts
type ColorCoordinate = ColorChannel | 'hue' | 'saturation' | 'lightness' | 'value' | 'cyan' | 'magenta' | 'yellow' | 'black' | 'chroma'
```

#### `ColorCoordinateValue`

| Name | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `coordinate` | `ColorCoordinate` | Yes |
| `label` | `string` | Yes |
| `value` | `number` | Yes |
| `min` | `number` | Yes |
| `max` | `number` | Yes |
| `step` | `number` | Yes |
| `unit` | `'' \| '%' \| '°'` | Yes |

#### `ColorFormat`

```ts
type ColorFormat = 'hex' | 'rgb' | 'hsl' | 'hsv' | 'cmyk' | 'oklch'
```

#### `ColorModel`

```ts
type ColorModel = Exclude<ColorFormat, 'hex'>
```

#### `ColorPickerPolicies`

| Name | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowAlpha` | `boolean` | — |
| `channelStep` | `number` | — |
| `alphaStep` | `number` | — |

  <td><span aria-label="None">—</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td><code class="component-part-token">value-text</code></td>
  <td><code>[data-part="value-text"]</code></td>
  <td>Displays the formatted value as text.</td>
  <td><span aria-label="None">—</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td><code class="component-part-token">format-trigger</code></td>
  <td><code>[data-part="format-trigger"]</code></td>
  <td>Changes the active value format.</td>
  <td><span aria-label="None">—</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | Adjust the active color coordinate or slider. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Commit a typed color value. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancel the typed draft and restore the accepted color. |

## Accessibility

Text inputs and sliders expose labels, ranges, current values, and channel purpose without relying on color alone.
